title: Signature Mirror Maker
description: Higgins' mirror maker crafts honest twins: the reflection true, the pairing deep, the honesty certified. The maker's mirrors don't flatter.

demo.code:
import random, math
random.seed(1001)
n=100
# Twin: machine temperature. Physical: T += 0.1*(setpoint-T) + noise. Twin: same model, no noise.
setpoint=80.0
T_phys=20.0; T_twin=20.0
errs=[]
for i in range(n):
    T_phys += 0.1*(setpoint-T_phys) + random.gauss(0,0.5)
    T_twin += 0.1*(setpoint-T_twin)
    errs.append(abs(T_phys-T_twin))
mae=sum(errs)/n
sync = mae < 2.0
print(f"steps=100 setpoint={setpoint} final_physical={T_phys:.2f} final_twin={T_twin:.2f}")
print(f"mean_abs_sync_error={mae:.3f} degC twin_in_sync={sync}")
print("DEMO_OK" if sync else "DEMO_FAIL")
demo.output:
steps=100 setpoint=80.0 final_physical=80.40 final_twin=80.00
mean_abs_sync_error=0.779 degC twin_in_sync=True
DEMO_OK
